warnings: Warmup steps mix all listed days from their first saved checkpoint; step fractions cannot be reinterpreted as earlier chronological days.

Using several same-cutoff optimization snapshots as daily publications needs an explicit delayed-release protocol and fresh tests on distinct dates; existing next-day evidence cannot be transferred to those later windows.
Families have separate optimization lineages, vocabulary mapping and cohorts; do not splice checkpoints across families.
Earlier warmup checkpoints have permitted quality metadata but their full-candidate ranking adequacy and cache gaps have not been established.
